# Futasaku

> Futasaku is a free strategy card game for two, played in the browser on a hex board. Each player grows from a home tile, keeps their land connected and tries to cut the opponent off.

- Play: https://www.futasaku.com/
- Modes: a single-player campaign, practice against the computer at several levels, and online duels with friends or a random opponent (with an optional Blitz clock).
- Works on phones and desktops; no download or install needed. It can be added to the home screen.
- Accounts are optional; a guest can play straight away.
